product.title: Bloodsuckers Invaders
product.description: The night has fallen, and the creatures of darkness are closing in! Bloodsuckers Invaders is a retro arcade shooter inspired by Space Invaders but with a vampiric twist. Armed with a holy cross-shaped stake, your mission is to drive back wave after wave of bloodthirsty monsters before they overrun the land.

history.text: Game developed in 3 hours for Trijam #310 (https://itch.io/jam/trijam-310). Theme: "Vampires"
The game was brought to life with C# and Blazor WebAssembly, powered by my own game engine, Blazorame!

features.feature: Classic Atari 2600-style arcade action with pixel-perfect retro visuals!
Progressively harder waves of vampiric monsters.

quote.description: It's a great adaptation of a classic.
